arrest.jaymoskingdoms.halt.0: Halt! In the name of the crown!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.halt.2: You there! Hands where I can see them!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.resisted.0: Resisting arrest, are we? Have it your way.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.hauled.0: On your feet. The crown will see you now.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.0: Your Majesty, this one was caught at %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.1: Sire, a criminal for judgment. The charge: %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.present.2: We took this wretch in the act, Majesty. %s.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.0: A first offence. You are pardoned. Do not make me regret it.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.1: I am merciful today. Go, and sin no more.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.pardon.2: Let them go. Everyone deserves a second chance.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.1: A beating, so they remember the law.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.flog.2: Teach them a lesson they won't forget.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.0: You are banished from this realm. Never return.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.1: Get out of my kingdom, and do not come back.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.exile.2: Exile. Let the wilds have you.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.1: Death. Let this be a warning to all.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.execute.2: The sentence is death. Carry it out.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.exiled.2: Where am I supposed to go?
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.0: To the cells with you. Let the rats keep you company.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.1: Robbing the dead earns you the dark below. Take him down.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.verdict.jail.2: Lock him up. He'll see daylight when I say so.
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.jailed.0: Not the cells! Anything but the cells!
arrest.jaymoskingdoms.jailed.2: It was only boots... they didn't need boots...
